'''KL-6TLF7V/T''', also called '''KL-6T-LF7V/T''', '''Sixtee-El''', or '''6T-L''' for short, was a [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid]].

==Biography==
KL-6TLF7V/T began accompanying the [[Shashay]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Crying Dawn Singer]] when he first entered [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and traveled with him from performance to performance. KL-6TLF7V/T duties included translating for the Shashay and providing whatever personal services he required.<ref name="A" />

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Nestmothers of the Shashay]] entered into negotiation regarding the use of [[Crytal Nest]] as a new base, KL-6TLF7V/T became an Alliance agent. KL-6TLF7V/T's original personality was as a subservient and proper valet and translator. However, hidden Alliance programming caused a secondary personality, that of a heroic Rebel to develop.<ref name="A" />

==Characteristics==
KL-6TLF7V/T was an [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. Resembling a standard [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], it stood 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. The droid was [[Color/Legends|colored]] silver with red detailing. KL-6TLF7V/T [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]] had been programmed to allow the droid to move in a graceful way. KL-6TLF7V/T was equipped with two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], a [[Broadband antenna/Legends|broadband antenna]] receiver, a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], and a [[TranLang II communications module/Legends|TranLang II Communication module]] capable of accessing nearly three million languages. As an agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, KL-6TLF7V/T was outfitted with a hidden [[homing transponder]] and [[Security camera/Legends|security camera]].<ref name="A" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid's full designation is given as "KL-6TLFV/T" in the text, but as "KL-6T-LF7V/T" on his character template.
